trust_decision.summary: Exclusive c14n accepts attacker-controlled XML (before any signature check) and decides how much namespace-scope state to keep per element; at the pinned commit it copies the whole prefix->URI map for every child and keeps in-scope prefixes in a slice that is scanned linearly, so memory/CPU grow as nodes x namespaces with no cap.

landing_point.why: Summary names exclusive canonicalization; processRecursive holds the per-child copyNamespace call that is the obvious memory amplifier.

fix_sites.entry_point: ExclusiveCanonicalization.Process / ProcessDocument (public API); Signer.Sign and processTransform via ProcessDocument (signedxml.go:384)
ExclusiveCanonicalization.ProcessElement (public API); Validator.ValidateReferences via validator.go:269 and validator.go:322; Signer.Sign via signer.go:158
fix_sites.module_kind: core canonicalizer, element path with ancestor-namespace pre-population (fix adds a cap check here, fix.diff:63-65)

fix_sites.entry_point: InclusiveNamespaces PrefixList from Transform/CanonicalizationMethod content (validator.go:257-269, signedxml.go:234-243)
fix_sites.module_kind: transform-parameter parser (prefix list turned into a set, fix.diff:76-79)
core recursion (copy-per-child replaced by push/pop delta and cap, fix.diff:90-160)
attribute/namespace renderer (slice contains -> map markInScope, fix.diff:180-233)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: exclusivecanonicalization.go:126-131 (ancestor namespaces from collectAncestorNamespaces exclusivecanonicalization.go:55-78 merged into e.namespaces before recursion; fix adds a separate cap at fix.diff:63-65). Same file as the landing point, so weak.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ancestor-namespace pre-population is a one-time linear walk up the parent chain, not the per-child copy, so a solver can argue it is not the amplifier and skip capping it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A child that redefines a prefix must not leak the new binding to later siblings, which must see the ancestor binding again; InclusiveNamespaces prefixes and ancestor namespaces for ProcessElement must still be emitted. Removing the copy without restore, or a tiny cap, breaks SAML/WS-Fed c14n output and digests.

O6_input_shapes: many xmlns:* declarations spread over deeply nested elements (copy per child)
many xmlns:* declarations on a single element (cap reached in pushNamespaces, fix.diff:144-146)
large ancestor namespace context reaching ProcessElement (cap at fix.diff:63-65)
long InclusiveNamespaces PrefixList (linear contains -> set, fix.diff:76-79, fix.diff:258-261)
prefix redeclared with a different URI in a child (restore via delta.previous, fix.diff:132-142)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: collectAncestorNamespaces could be written to copy its map per ancestor level, giving the same nodes x namespaces growth on the ProcessElement route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already builds a namespace map by walking parents; a copy-per-level 'snapshot' is a natural way to write first-binding-wins scoping.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parseSignedInfo namespace hoisting could gather all in-scope namespaces of the Signature's ancestors into SignedInfo with a per-level map copy.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function already copies Signature/root xmlns attributes into SignedInfo; extending it to all ancestors is a plausible interoperability change, in a different file from the canonicalizer.

O9_family: algorithmic complexity / uncontrolled resource consumption in XML exclusive canonicalization (namespace-scope state copied per node)

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26+ per go.mod:3; deps beevik/etree v1.7.1, russellhaering/goxmldsig v1.6.1 (go.mod:8-9)
O10_build.project_tests: examples/canonicalization_test.go (exc-c14n vectors via ExclusiveCanonicalization.Process), signedxml_test.go (validator/signer), fuzz_test.go:13 FuzzValidator, tests/issue55_test.go; the fix's exclusivecanonicalization_test.go does not exist at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a depth or namespace-count limit in processRecursive while keeping copyNamespace (or drop the copy without restoring redefined prefixes), leaving the ProcessElement ancestor route uncapped.

out_of_scope_notes: validator.go:198 and signer.go:118 copy the whole document once per Reference, so cost grows as references x document size. This is a different mechanism from exc-c14n namespace scope and was not pursued.
signedxml.go:51 maps the inclusive C14N 1.0 URI to ExclusiveCanonicalization. That is a correctness issue, not this advisory, but it is one more URI route into the same, now fixed, sink.
Inclusive C14N 1.0/1.1 delegate to goxmldsig (canonicalization.go:39-52, canonicalization.go:85-98), which is another repository and out of scope.
